fichas.title: Bathroom planning and fitting-out guidelines
fichas.summary: Bathroom movement-area standards were withdrawn without replacement in 2007 because they inadequately considered disabled people. The dimensions shown are absolute minimums; movement areas should generally follow the Accessible building standard. Bathrooms should use easy-to-clean surfaces, moisture-managing wall and ceiling plaster, and slip-resistant flooring. If there is no laundry room, provide space and connections for laundry equipment. Provide an earthed socket by the mirror, storage, a towel rail, and hand grips above the bath.
uses: Laundry where no separate laundry room is available
